India seal semi-final spot with 2-1 win over Japan in FIH Hockey Women’s Nations Cup 2026
The Indian Women's Hockey Team secured their place in the semi-finals of the FIH Hockey Women's Nations Cup 2026 after defeating Japan 2-1 in their second Pool A match on June 16 at the North Harbour National Hockey Centre in Auckland, New Zealand. Captain Salima Tete and Lalremsiami scored for India, while Hiramitsu Ai was the lone scorer for Japan as India maintained their unbeaten run and moved to the top of Pool A.
